internal_discovery.plain_explanation: Across the Quran, qwy words mean STRENGTH understood as a possessed capacity or force that is the opposite of weakness. The clearest internal proof is 30:54, where God creates humans from weakness (ḍaʿf), then gives quwwah, then weakness again — quwwah is literally defined as the middle strong-phase between two weaknesses. This one sense fits the strong-and-doomed nations who were 'greater in quwwah' yet destroyed (30:9, 40:82, 41:15), the possessed might of peoples and war-materiel (27:33, 8:60), God as al-Qawiyy who seizes and helps (8:52, 22:40), the firmness of spun yarn before it unravels (16:92), and the resolute grip on Scripture (khudh… bi-quwwah, 2:63, 19:12). It carries no promise of virtue, permanence, or victory. Only one word resists: al-muqwīn (56:73), a lone Form-IV form whose meaning cannot be recovered from any other qwy occurrence, so it is left open.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: quwwah does NOT entail: (1) virtue or divine favour — it is repeatedly the trait of the arrogant and doomed (Qarun's retinue 28:76, ʿĀd 41:15, destroyed towns 47:13, 40:82); (2) permanence — 30:54 makes it a transient life-stage bracketed by weakness; (3) the outcome (victory/dominance) — 'stronger in quwwah' nations are still annihilated (30:9, 35:44, 9:69, 28:78), and God's being qawiyy grounds naṣr/ghalaba which the text keeps as SEPARATE verbs (22:40, 58:21); (4) animate/physical only — it applies to inanimate yarn-firmness (16:92) and abstract totality (2:165, 18:39); (5) synonymy with its collocates — co-occurrence with ʿazīz, baʾs, shadīd, matīn proves qwy is the capacity/firm-force component specifically, not those neighbours.
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 56:73:5:3 al-muqwīn (لِّلْمُقْوِينَ): the sole Form-IV participle and a hapax. In 'We made it (the fire) a reminder and a provision li-l-muqwīn,' the context supplies NO ḍaʿf/quwwah contrast, no comparative grading, no capacity or agency frame. Its link to the quwwa~qawiyy strength-nucleus is purely morphological, and morphology is not semantic authority under the contract (same root ≠ one meaning). Its sense is not recoverable from the other 41 occurrences on Quran-internal evidence alone, so it is a lexicalized, unbridged isolate that resists the account and caps the root-level claim at MODERATE / REPRESENTATIVE.
internal_discovery.strongest_competitor: Two competitors, both weaker. (a) Generic 'power/might': fits the 41 non-outlier tokens but erases the distinctions the text itself draws (quwwah vs ʿizzah/baʾs/shiddah/matānah) and misses the decisive ḍaʿf-antonymy at 30:54 — an over-broad abstraction. (b) Pure 'firmness/solidity' (from 16:92 yarn + matīn + the bi-quwwah grip): elegant for static cases but under-covers the dynamic-agentive tokens — additive military quwwah (8:60, 11:52) and God's power-to-seize (8:52) are force-to-act, not mere firmness. The adopted account ('firm effective capacity, antonym of ḍaʿf') subsumes both and is anchored by 30:54; the two competitors converge on 'the strong state opposed to weakness,' which is itself evidence the defensible nucleus is a broad property, arguing against over-grading to STRONG.

candidate_root_contribution: qwy contributes POSSESSED CAPACITY / FORCE — the strong-pole explicitly opposed to weakness (ḍaʿf) — the firm effective capacity by which a thing resists dissolution and can act, overpower, or endure. It is graded (ashadd… quwwatan), possessable (ulū/dhū quwwah), additive (quwwatan ilā quwwatikum, 11:52), transient (a middle stage between two ḍaʿf, 30:54), and scales seamlessly from creature to Creator (41:15). This single nucleus governs the entire quwwa (noun) / qawiyy (adj·N) / quwā (plural) derivational family (41/42). It is distinct from its intensity-operator (shdd: ashadd quwwatan, shadīd al-quwā), from dominance/invincibility (ʿzz: al-qawiyy al-ʿazīz), from solidity (mtn: dhū al-quwwah al-matīn), and from martial valour (baʾs: enumerated separately at 27:33). One Form-IV lexicalized derivative, al-muqwīn (56:73), stands outside this nucleus and is left unresolved.

evidence_basis.statement: 56:73:5:3 al-muqwīn (لِّلْمُقْوِينَ): the sole Form-IV participle and a hapax. In 'We made it (the fire) a reminder and a provision li-l-muqwīn,' the context supplies NO ḍaʿf/quwwah contrast, no comparative grading, no capacity or agency frame. Its link to the quwwa~qawiyy strength-nucleus is purely morphological, and morphology is not semantic authority under the contract (same root ≠ one meaning). Its sense is not recoverable from the other 41 occurrences on Quran-internal evidence alone, so it is a lexicalized, unbridged isolate that resists the account and caps the root-level claim at MODERATE / REPRESENTATIVE.

hard_case_representation.rationale: One occurrence (56:73 al-muqwīn) genuinely resists the nucleus and is left UNRESOLVED; it is recorded as a RESISTANT_SEAM hard case and listed in counterevidence_refs. The core account holds for the remaining 41/42, so this is a bounded resistance within a PREFERRED family claim, not a global failure.

rejection_condition.challenging_finding: A quwwa/qawiyy/quwā token would have to carry a settled internal meaning that is NOT possessed-capacity/anti-weakness — e.g. a token where quwwah demonstrably means moral virtue, divine favour, guaranteed victory, or permanent trait rather than force/capacity.
rejection_condition.search_location: The 41 family tokens, especially the ruin-formula comparatives (30:9, 35:44, 40:21, 40:82, 41:15×2, 47:13, 9:69, 28:78) and the divine qawiyy-ʿazīz / qawiyy-shadīd-al-ʿiqāb frames (11:66, 22:40, 22:74, 42:19, 57:25, 58:21, 8:52, 40:22).
rejection_condition.verification_method: Re-read each token's verse_text for an internal ḍaʿf/quwwah contrast, comparative grading (ashadd quwwatan), possession (ulū/dhū quwwah), or predication frame, and confirm the operative sense is force/capacity, not outcome, virtue, or permanence.
rejection_condition.confounder_control: Hold quwwah apart from its co-listed neighbours via actual co-occurrence — quwwa vs baʾs (27:33), quwwa vs matīn (51:58), quwā graded by shadīd (53:5), quwwa juxtaposed with ʿazīz (11:66) — so a neighbour's sense (dominance, solidity, martial force, intensity) is not misattributed to qwy.
rejection_condition.failure_consequence: If such a token is confirmed, the single-nucleus family account is downgraded and the noun/adjective system is split into multiple non-bridged senses, forcing an UNRESOLVED / multi-class result instead of REPRESENTATIVE.

reopen_conditions: If Quran-internal evidence emerges that bridges al-muqwīn (56:73) to the quwwa/qawiyy capacity nucleus — e.g. a second qwy Form-IV occurrence or an internal ḍaʿf/quwwah link within 56:71-73 — re-grade the root toward STRONG / UNIVERSAL.

If the bi-quwwah grip-idiom (2:63, 2:93, 7:145, 7:171, 19:12) or the inanimate yarn-firmness token (16:92) is shown to be a separate lexeme not bridgeable to possessed-capacity, split the noun class and reopen the partition.
If any ruin-formula ashadd-quwwatan token (e.g. 41:15, 40:82, 9:69) is shown to entail outcome/victory rather than mere capacity, revisit and possibly retract the capacity≠victory negative boundary.

falsification_evidence.status_rationale: A full adversarial refutation returning SUPPORTED with failing_occurrences=[] cannot be claimed because one occurrence (56:73 al-muqwīn) materially resists and stays UNRESOLVED. The core nucleus holds adversarially clean across the other 41 tokens with a genuine internal anchor (30:54) and distinctiveness from shdd/ʿzz/mtn/baʾs, so the result is not FAILED/REJECTED; per contract the honest status is NOT_RUN with the resistant token recorded.
